title: On the Uniqueness of Ghost-Free Multi-Gravity -- II: Constraining antisymmetrised multi spin-2 interactions
summary: So far, only a single theory of multiple spin-2 fields is known that features genuine multi-field interactions while remaining free of Boulware-Deser-type ghost instabilities. In this paper we show that this is the most general ghost-free multi spin-2 interaction type possible. We start with the general class of multivielbein interactions containing antisymmetrised products of vielbeins, considered earlier by Hinterbichler and Rosen.
